name: faebloom_trick_castable_with_no_opposing_creature
notes: Printed: '... When you do, tap target creature an opponent controls.' The target belongs to the reflexive trigger, not to the spell: with no creature on seat 1's side Faebloom Trick is still cast and makes its two Faeries; the trigger has no legal target and does nothing, so seat 0's own 2/2 and the Faeries stay untapped.
